author: Growlow
quote:
I've been playing GTA since its conception. To even put GTA on this p.o.s is a joke. When are game studios going to wake up and realize meeting quotas and hiring woke liberal women to work on a working model is suicide. We wait 13 yrs, and Rockstar increases the price $10, and this is the bs we get? 

On principle I won't buy another Rockstar game. Because I KNOW that the same virtue signaling women that ruined this game will ruin the next RDR. I'll just replay GTA 5 and RDR2 for the next two decades because Rockstar is absolutely COOKED.
